reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text:
My favorite cleanser! I have sensitive, allergy prone skin, and this is gentle enough to keep my skin calm, while also helping with acne. 
I had a cleanser I liked a while ago, but then they changed the formula, and in order to replace it I had to switch between three different cleansers. After getting this, I'm back down to just one, thank goodness!
reviews.zh: 最鍾意嘅潔面！我有敏感、易過敏嘅皮膚，但呢款夠溫和，可以穩定膚況，仲有助改善暗瘡。之前有支心水潔面，但品牌轉咗配方，之後我要喺三支唔同嘅潔面之間轉住用。換咗呢支之後終於得返一支，感恩！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: I thought it would be very gentle, because of its name. So I ordered it to use in alternative to my other cleanser with aha/bha acids. But actually it felt even more deep cleaning, that my other one and my skin felt tight for a few minutes. Overall it is good cleanser, but probably not for a very sensitive skin type
reviews.zh: 以為個名咁溫和，用落應該都好溫和。所以買咗返嚟同另一支有 aha/bha 酸性成分嘅潔面交替用。但實際用落感覺仲深層清潔過我嗰支，仲有皮膚繃緊咗幾分鐘。整體嚟講係一支好嘅潔面，但可能唔太啱超敏感肌。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: I had Round Lab dokdo face wash and birch juice face wash.Currently I’m using Round Lab pine cica serum and cream it really suits my skin calms redness.Now I bought Round Lab pine calming cica face wash
reviews.zh: 用過 Round Lab dokdo 潔面同 birch juice 潔面。而家用緊 Round Lab pine cica 精華同面霜，啱晒我塊面，可以紓緩泛紅。而家買咗 Round Lab pine calming cica 潔面。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: very happy with this. I was getting Round Lab sunscreen and randomly saw this and decided to try it. deep cleansing with nice skin afterwards, ready for some moisture and sunscreen. wouldn't mind a restock.
reviews.zh: 對呢個好滿意。本來買緊 Round Lab 防晒，隨便見到呢個就試下。深層清潔，洗完皮膚狀態唔錯，之後就可以塗保濕同防晒。會想再回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: Although it’s not that moisturizing, it takes away excess sebum in return. If you get oily during the day, washing your face at the end of the day with this really makes you feel clean. This is more suited for summer. Anyways, it’s a really great cleanser.
reviews.zh: 雖然保濕效果一般，但相對地可以帶走多餘皮脂。如果你成日面油多，夜晚用呢個洗完面真係會覺得好乾淨。比較適合夏天用。總之係一款好好用嘅潔面乳。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text:
My favourite cleanser ever 🙏 It doesn't strip my skin but it still cleans very well. It foams up very easily and it smells good (it doesn't have fragrance btw!)
My skin feels hydrated afterwards and i noticed it helps with my redness. I recommend especially if you have oily/combo skin. Its very soothing so sensitive skin can also use it, there is salicylic acid in it though. I personally have combo sensitive skin and i had no problems with it ☺️
reviews.zh: 我用過最鍾意嘅潔面乳🙏 唔會抽乾皮膚水分，但清潔力都好足夠。起泡好容易，味道都唔錯（不過其實冇加香精！）洗完之後皮膚覺得保濕，我留意到有助紓緩泛紅。尤其推薦油性／混合性肌膚用。佢好舒緩，所以敏感肌都用得，不過入面有水楊酸。我自己係混合敏感肌，用落完全冇問題☺️

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: This cleanser is OK. It thoroughly cleanses the skin and does not cause irritation. The rate is 3 stars because it leaves the skin feeling a little bit on the dry side. It is not an uncomfortable experience, especially if you follow up with a toner/essence/moisturizer.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面乳OK。清潔得好乾淨，唔會刺激皮膚。俾3星係因為用完之後皮膚會有少少乾。唔算好差嘅體驗，尤其如果你跟住會用爽膚水／精華／保濕霜。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: I think I found my permanent foam cleanser. I’ve used the toner pad, moisturizer, and ampoule that’s in the same line as this cleanser and really liked those products. The satisfaction I felt from those products can be felt with this. The soothing ingredients are definitely there and help make the cleanser feel gentle for sensitive skin. The scent is also similarly very subtle.
reviews.zh: 我覺得我搵到命定嘅泡沫潔面乳。之前用過同系列嘅爽膚水棉片、保濕霜同安瓶，都好滿意。嗰啲產品俾我嘅滿足感，呢支潔面乳一樣做得到。舒緩成分真係有落，令呢款潔面乳對敏感肌好溫和。味道同樣好淡。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
